findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
The facility could not locate any test strips (quat). Ensure that test strips are available to accurately measure sanitizer concentrations properly. Will follow up 5/31/2024. 

4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Hot and cold water available; adequate pressure
findings.comment:
Observed the handwashing sink to not have an adequate flow of hot water. Ensure that the handwashing sink has an adequate flow of running hot water to wash hands properly. Will follow up 5/31/2024. 

5-103.12: Water under pressure shall be provided to all fixtures, EQUIPMENT, and nonFOOD EQUIPMENT that are required to use water except that water (A) and (B) to a TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT or in response to a temporary interruption of a water supply need not be under pressure.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.11: Observed the bar hand sink to not have hand soap at the start of the inspection. Ensure hand sinks are supplied with soap. Soap was put at the hand sink during the inspection. 
Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.
